shortlist.name: Padhma - Calm Kannada Audiobook
shortlist.why_shortlisted: Audiobook register is the closest thing in the library to long-form documentary narration, and high_quality is the safer category on v3. Female, matching the brief primary.

shortlist.name: Sharadhi - Natural Kannada Conversation
shortlist.why_shortlisted: Female, high_quality, described as natural rather than performed. Conversational register is the risk to listen for.

shortlist.name: Aisiri - Warm Kannada Narration
shortlist.v3_risk: Professional Voice Clone: documented as weaker on v3, and v3 is the only model that speaks Kannada
shortlist.why_shortlisted: The single best description against the brief: warm Kannada narration, well paced. Held third only because it is a Professional Voice Clone and those are documented as weaker on v3.

shortlist.name: Mani - Steady Kannada Storyteller
shortlist.why_shortlisted: Male alternative. Described as trusting the story enough not to perform it, which is exactly the brief. high_quality.

shortlist.name: Srivatsa - Kannada Narration
